answer: A farm as a result pays the burn once for each extra identity on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. The vertex debit happens at intake, wander totals the burned amount, and falcon anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 28 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. That is 35 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
